title: 日本ダービーの後に・挽回に向けて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vodka gives the Japanese Derby everything she has, but she doesn't win the title.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even with the loss, she doesn't regret running in the race of her dreams.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At the press conference after the race, Vodka declares that she will keep up this momentum by going to run internationally.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This challenge was not in our plans, but it's too late to take it back now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I give her the okay, and Vodka gets excited to go abroad.
